column1: # Host system call shim inventory (D35). Every libSystem symbol imported by a built prx library (libc included).
# Columns: symbol, class, handling, note. Checked by tools/mac/check_host_imports.py (test host_import_inventory).
# class: buffer (kernel reads or writes a user buffer), path (kernel reads a path string), stdio, address (guest
#   address identity), retaining (a buffer pointer is stored or returned), scalar (kernel call, no pointer),
#   userspace (no kernel access to a guest pointer: slow at worst, never EFAULT), data.
# handling: shim (HostSyscallShim.cpp defines it), hand (translated by its callers), none.
